title: tagetes belenidium
intro: Tagetes belenidium, commonly known as Mexican Marigold or Mexican Tarragon, is a perennial plant in the sunflower family native to Mexico. This plant is known for its vibrant yellow and orange flowers and is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, helping to reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Tagetes belenidium include acting as a diaphoretic, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it useful for treating colds, coughs, and other respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
